briefings.title: Energy and AI: Sustainable, Sovereign Industrial Campuses | Alain Wilmouth, 2CRSi | RAISE 2026
briefings.tldr: 2CRSi CEO Alain Wilmouth and host Ethan Pierse discuss building sustainable, sovereign industrial AI infrastructure across Europe, detailing a new French consortium ("Aether") that combines immersion cooling, biomass energy, and unused agricultural land to power edge AI data centers while generating negative carbon emissions.
